info.title: API.SH: Trustpilot
info.description: The Trustpilot API from API.SH: public Trustpilot data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The search box's company suggestions for what was typed: business id, name, domain, TrustScore, stars, number of reviews, category, logo and review page link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustpilot-autocomplete

get.description:
Every Trustpilot category with its subcategories. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustpilot-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country. Accepted for compatibility; Trustpilot's category tree is the same in every country (checked Oct 2026), so the list does not change. To list a country's businesses, pass `country` to `/trustpilot/v1/category`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A company's Trustpilot profile and one page of its reviews: name, website, TrustScore, stars, review count, categories, verification, contact, review statistics, logo, claimed and closed flags, location, plus `rating_distribution` (review counts for 1-5 stars and the total), `reviews_last_12_months`, `primary_category`, `category_path`, `country`, `temporarily_closed` and `similar_companies` (id, name, domain, link, TrustScore, stars, review count, logo). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustpilot-company

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

get.description:
Companies on Trustpilot matching a name or keyword: id, name, domain, TrustScore, stars, review count, location, categories, logo, profile link, website and contact, with the total. Filter by minimum TrustScore, claimed profiles, minimum review count and city; the answer echoes them as `filters`. `matching_categories` lists the Trustpilot categories that match the query (id, name, parent): the search itself has no category filter or sort, so use `/trustpilot/v1/category` with that id to sort a category's companies by relevance, review count or latest review. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustpilot-search

parameters.name: trustscore
parameters.description: Only companies with at least this TrustScore.

parameters.name: claimed
parameters.description: true: only companies that claimed their profile.

parameters.name: min_reviews
parameters.description: Only companies with at least this many reviews (e.g. 25, 100, 250).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Trustpilot reviewer's public profile: display name, country, number of reviews, reads and likes, verified flag, avatar, and their reviews of companies (rating, title, text, language, likes, published and experience dates, verification, the company reviewed with its Trustpilot link, and the company's reply). Paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trustpilot-user

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The reviewer id (author_id in /trustpilot/v1/reviews), or a trustpilot.com/users/<id> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
